documents.description: Plain-language summary of the Claude Manager workspace and its role in the ecosystem.

documents.title: QI Ecosystem Dashboard

documents.title: Dashboard scaffolding
documents.description: Supervisor output and a Dashboard working folder for management views.

documents.title: Status snapshot
documents.description: Local status snapshot for the workspace (distinct from the ecosystem status.json the supervisor feeds at C:\QIH\data\).

documents.title: Global Standing Instructions
documents.description: The user-global SOP every session obeys: QI ecosystem registry rules, service naming, session start/end protocol, dispatch + delegation policy, MCP discipline.

documents.title: Dispatch Protocol
documents.description: The standing routing rule: trigger->agent table, Workflows A/B/C, anti-patterns, end-of-session ritual, session-start verification. Turns the agent files into an operating mode.

documents.title: hive-architect
documents.description: Opus design agent — ADRs, multi-project impact, implementation plans. No production code.

documents.title: hive-builder
documents.description: Sonnet execution agent — Python/SQL/FastAPI/config, QI conventions baked in.

documents.title: hive-inspector
documents.description: Sonnet read-only review agent — 7-point checklist, [CRITICAL]/[MAJOR]/[MINOR]/[NIT] findings.

documents.title: hive-ops
documents.description: Haiku service-triage agent — QI_ services, nssm restarts via gsudo, port owners, orphan kills.

documents.title: hive-scout
documents.description: Haiku research agent — fast, cited, <300 words, surfaces options without deciding.

documents.title: hive-scribe
documents.description: Haiku documentation agent — .docx session summaries, meeting minutes, version histories.

documents.title: hive-tester
documents.description: Haiku test runner — pytest, health sweeps, qi_validator; never edits tests to pass.

documents.title: hive-librarian
documents.description: Sonnet doc-retrieval/curation agent over the Documentation Brain (docs + doc_relationships + qi_docs Chroma).

documents.title: Project settings
documents.description: Permissions (bypassPermissions + allow list) and the SessionEnd + SubagentStop hook commands.

documents.title: SessionStart hook
documents.description: Injects ecosystem briefing + live Brain probe (fail-loud) + dispatch reminder + monthly-audit gate as additionalContext. Note: probes Brain on stale :9010.

documents.title: SessionEnd hook
documents.description: Auto-stubs every session to the Hive inbox -> QI_HiveIngest -> qi_brain.db. Infers project from cwd vs registry.

documents.title: SubagentStop hook
documents.description: Attributes finished sub-agent work to the right hive_<role> in the Brain inbox.

documents.title: UserPromptSubmit hook
documents.description: Loads a project's full context the moment its name is mentioned mid-session (referenced by session_context.py).

documents.title: Supervisor
documents.description: Reads qi_registry.json, inspects every project for git/service/task/keepalive drift, writes DASHBOARD.md + report.json + feeds C:\QIH\data\status.json.

documents.title: Supervisor report
documents.description: Machine-readable full findings from the last supervisor run.

documents.title: Claude restart guard
documents.description: -Scan/-Clean/-CleanOrphans/-Locks. Clears the 'file in use' lock by killing orphaned Claude+MCP trees; protects QI_ services and its own chain.

documents.title: Clean-Restart wrapper
documents.description: Explorer-run Scan -> Clean -> verify -> relaunch Claude Desktop, no reboot.

documents.title: Monthly self-audit
documents.description: Read-only audit + optional --apply-safe (orphans, clean worktrees, .claude.json bloat). Writes .md + .docx + PENDING_REVIEW.json.

documents.title: Self-audit orchestrator
documents.description: QI_ClaudeSelfAudit task body — audit + Tasuke notify + auto-open Claude for the decision gate. Headless via conhost.

documents.title: Tasuke notifier
documents.description: LINE broadcast to the owner via the Tasuke OA; token from C:\OC\secrets\tasuke-line.env.

documents.title: Brain reconciliation pass
documents.description: Register projects, refresh project_state for 15 projects, merge bad session IDs, backfill missing sessions in qi_brain.db.

documents.title: Secrets migration (round 2)
documents.description: Move hardcoded secrets to env files across the ecosystem.

documents.title: Maia env migration / service restart
documents.description: Maia-side environment migration and NSSM service restart helpers run from the management workspace.

documents.title: Service-rights grant
documents.description: One-off: grant the Claude/service account rights to manage QI_ services.

documents.title: MCP config patcher
documents.description: One-off patcher for ~/.claude.json / MCP server entries.

documents.title: QI Hive overview generator
documents.description: python-docx generator for the QI Hive overview Word document (heading styles, tables, colored runs, margins).

documents.title: QI Hive projects appendix
documents.description: Appends a per-project section to the QI Hive overview document.

documents.title: Latest-summary generator
documents.description: Generates the latest session/overview document.
